what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in the United Kingdom: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3652 Indian asylum seekers in the United Kingdom, 2.0% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, Portugal and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India and over the government of India in every year from 2006 to 2025.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2011 at 287 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 6446, at the end of 2023; the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United Kingdom only.
